mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contracts c INNER JOIN project_applications pa ON c.contract_id = pa.application_id WHERE pa.freelancer_id = #{userId} AND c.contract_status IN ('SIGNED', 'PAID')
SELECT COALESCE(total_earned, 0) FROM freelancer_wallets WHERE freelancer_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_applications WHERE freelancer_id = #{userId} AND application_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COALESCE(balance, 0) FROM freelancer_wallets WHERE freelancer_id = #{userId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wh.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(wh.amount) AS totalAmount FROM wallet_histories wh INNER JOIN freelancer_wallets fw ON wh.wallet_id = fw.wallet_id WHERE fw.freelancer_id = #{userId} AND wh.io_type = 'PAYMENT' AND wh.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(wh.created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT c.contract_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM contracts c INNER JOIN project_applications pa ON c.contract_id = pa.application_id WHERE pa.freelancer_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.contract_status

SELECT p.project_id, p.title, p.budget, p.est_duration AS estDuration, pa.application_status AS applicationStatus, pa.applied_at AS appliedAt FROM project_applications pa JOIN projects p ON pa.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pa.freelancer_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pa.applied_at DESC LIMIT 3
